Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ فِيْهِ مَا يُرْضِيكَ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You in this [month/day] for what pleases You
And I seek refuge in You from what displeases You

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ التَّوْفِيقَ فِيْهِ لِأَنْ أُطِيعَكَ وَلَا أَعْصِيَكَ
Translation: And I ask You for success in it to obey You and not disobey You
O Most Generous to those who ask
